versions.changelog:
- Fix the canonical ClawHub plugin link used across the skill listing.
- Refresh launch copy with clearer CTA, screenshot plan, and real-review prompts.
- Keep GitHub, demo, and marketplace routes aligned to one plugin page.

- Refine ClawHub skill positioning so it delivers real readability value.
- Add clearer trust boundaries and canonical routing to the plugin page.
- Expand marketplace-safe copy guidance and forbidden-claims checks.
- Fix automatic remote-version detection in the local skill publish script.

- Initial release of the readable-output skill.
- Provides a readability-focused layout for AI replies, grouping content into sections like overview, key points, warnings, next steps, and reminders.
- Supports language-aware formatting for English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Arabic/Hebrew.
- Maintains separation between readable content and code or raw text.
- Designed for use cases needing clearer output structure without altering original meaning.
